text:
elaine-cs: Heads-up — Stitch hit a burst of 429s during their CI-driven warmup when onboarding. Theyre doing a mass container spin-up before their SSO switch tomorrow and said the SDK init calls are being rate-limited.
elaine-cs: Customer snippet (mobile RN):
```
POST /v1/client/init HTTP/1.1
Host: api.redwood.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <ephemeral-token>
User-Agent: StitchMobile/4.2
X-Forwarded-For: 35.204.4.10
Response: 429 {"error":"rate_limit","retry_after":3}
```
mateo-cs: Theyre on rn-mobile-sdk v0.9.0 and doing 20 parallel warmup jobs in CI. Also mentioned intermittent 401s when tokens rotate simultaneously.
vikram-eng: Quick diagnosis idea: their outbound SNI or egress region is skewed and landing on an overloaded edge cluster. If preflight/init traffic fans out across replicas, tenant caps can trip quickly. Can you share the traceroutes or client IPs?
elaine-cs: Sent the three edge IPs they dialed: 34.83.12.45, 34.86.7.191, 203.0.113.9.
ops-bot: noticed anomaly: tenant=t-stitch-42 spike at 2026-03-22T22:14:03Z — concurrent init requests=22, ephemeral rotations in 4s window.
dev-rel: Immediate customer guidance to reduce impact: 1) set explicit region/edge in SDK init, 2) add exponential backoff + jitter for token refresh, 3) limit warmup concurrency to 3-6. Provide code snippet?
onboard-engineer: Snippet we can send for RN: 
```js
import Redwood from 'redwood-mobile';
Redwood.init({
  apiKey: '__ephemeral__',
  edge: 'eu-west-1',
  preflight: { maxConcurrency: 4 },
  auth: { refreshJitterMs: 250 }
});
```
vikram-eng: On the infra side we can: (A) temporarily raise their tenant preflight cap 12->60 for 12h, (B) enable edge header fallback so X-Redwood-Edge wins over DNS routing for preflight endpoints, or (C) add a per-tenant grace window in rate limiter. Ops decision required.
mateo-cs: Customer prefers ops bump for immediate unblocking. They gave tenant id t-stitch-42 and confirmed acceptance of temporary exception.
ops-bot: ticket created: INC-9489 — request: temporary preflight cap bump for t-stitch-42 to 60 until 2026-03-23T06:00:00Z. tagged infra + edge-team.
vikram-eng: I'll push a tiny canary to accept X-Redwood-Edge for preflight requests only (low blast radius) — this will help misrouted traffic.
dev-rel: Also advise them to upgrade to rn-mobile-sdk v1.0.0 (patch in v1.0.0: token refresh jitter + default preflight.maxConcurrency=3).
elaine-cs: Ive sent the RN snippet + suggested upgrade + asked them to throttle CI warmups to 4 concurrent jobs. Theyre going to try that now and report back.
onboard-engineer: Follow-ups: 1) Ops confirm when bump applied, 2) infra to evaluate edge fallback canary, 3) update onboarding doc with a short playbook on warmup best practices.
mateo-cs: Please ping when INC-9489 is closed. Ill coordinate with the customer SSO cutover window.
ops-bot: update: INC-9489 approved and cap increased. Monitor metrics for t-stitch-42 for the next 12h.
elaine-cs: Thanks everyone — Ill post a short retro in onboarding channel after tomorrow. :pray:
